root_causes.description: Context slots (e.g. order_id='ORD-025') are unconditionally merged into entities. Step 8 (ORDER_INQUIRY) checks if 'order_id' in entities before Step 11 (PRODUCT_INQUIRY) is evaluated. Any explicit product query executed in a session with an active order context is hijacked into ORDER_INQUIRY.

ctx.update_slots() persists extracted entities into ConversationContext immediately after routing, BEFORE _check_ownership() validates authorization. Querying an unowned entity (e.g. ORD-003) persists active_order_id='ORD-003' despite security denial, causing subsequent generic queries to fail with false Access Denied.
ConversationContext.update_slots() never clears or expires old entity slots when switching domains (Order -> Product). Active order and product slots linger indefinitely together in memory.

security_assessment.data_leakage: NONE (Ownership checks prevented unauthorized data access)
security_assessment.availability_impact: HIGH (Unowned context persistent dirtying caused false denial of legitimate user queries)

recommended_fix_summary: Refactor IntentClassifier.classify() to prevent context order_id from overriding explicit current product entities/keywords.
Postpone ctx.update_slots() in AIOrchestrator until AFTER _check_ownership() authorization succeeds.
Implement domain slot clearing / precedence in ConversationContext when switching entity domains.
